text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky continues making adjustments. 
She still hasn't regained her prime form, 
but she steadily builds up her strength 
for the promised showdown at the Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Sakura Chiyono O "felt tired of 
eating, and her body was growing heavy." 
Which meant—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It suggested that Sakura Chiyono O had 
passed her peak and was heading toward the 
end of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there's still not enough 
information. Maybe it's just a matter of 
fatigue—Sakura Chiyono O speaks as if 
trying to convince herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet, once planted, the anxiety refused to 
leave her mind. She asked her Trainer 
almost like a prayer: "...I can become her 
rival, can't I?"
